name: Abubakarsq/10times-scraper
what_it_holds: Selenium/BeautifulSoup/Requests scraper for 10times.com event detail pages (name, date, venue, category). No committed dataset.

name: Qaisbhatti/eventbrite
what_it_holds: Python scraper for Eventbrite event listing pages, writes JSON/CSV. No committed dataset in the repo; extraction fields are basic (event name, date, location, category).
why_useful: Eventbrite skews toward smaller/local events rather than corporate conferences, so this is a weaker MICE proxy than 10times, but it is another non-Airbnb-site scraping method for the events-and-shocks gap (#11) and could pick up smaller local gatherings that move demand in secondary markets.
themes: Corporate travel and business-travel data (GBTA, Concur/SAP, Navan public indices, conference calendars), MICE datasets
why_all: Eventbrite skews toward smaller/local events rather than corporate conferences, so this is a weaker MICE proxy than 10times, but it is another non-Airbnb-site scraping method for the events-and-shocks gap (#11) and could pick up smaller local gatherings that move demand in secondary markets.

name: komalnpn/ratingsOfMeetupVenues
what_it_holds: Scraper combining Meetup.com event listings with the Google Places API to rate event venues by locality. No committed dataset (small student project), just a method.
why_useful: Marginal: Meetup skews to recurring small local groups (tech/social meetups), not MICE/business conferences, so this barely touches the business-travel theme; flagged only for completeness as a workable event-scraping pattern.
geography: Wherever Meetup has coverage (mostly US/EU cities)
themes: Corporate travel and business-travel data (GBTA, Concur/SAP, Navan public indices, conference calendars), MICE datasets

name: JMStratil/Create_DateDataset
what_it_holds: Base-R script that builds a daily calendar panel with school holidays, public holidays, and derived 'exposure' variables, computed from a Gregorian Easter algorithm and statutory holiday rules (no temperature/shapefile/population data, per its own description). Country/region scope and date range were not resolved on WebFetch (repo showed as empty on a second look, updated 8 Sep 2026, 0 stars) so contents could not be independently confirmed beyond the gh search snippet.
why_useful: If it actually runs, a generated school/public-holiday panel is a low-cost way to build an academic-calendar / long-weekend feature for nowcasting nights (gap area: student and school-break travel timing), but confirmation failed (WebFetch reported an empty repo) so this is speculative and should be re-checked before use.
geography: unclear, likely a single country (statutory-rule based)
themes: Student, seasonal-worker, medical and other niche travel-demand datasets; university calendars; military moves
